actions.name: Anionic
actions.description: Effect: If there is at least one other allied creature with the Plus, Cationic or Minus Ability on the field, the user's SPDEF stat is increased by 50%. If the user is within 5m of an ally with the Plus, Cationic, or Minus Ability, they gain the effect of that Ability.

system.description:
Effect: If there is at least one other allied creature with the Plus, Cationic or Minus Ability on the field, the user can deploy an @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-summons.Item.98IfIAKlpnNIdpHC]{Anionic Summon}, which grants +50% Special Defense to all allies with one of the corresponding abilities.

The Anionic Summon is terminated if the user is @Affliction[fainted] or removed from the field.
